# Guia Negocios

> Bilingual (Spanish/English) business consulting firm in Knoxville, Tennessee, helping Hispanic entrepreneurs and small business owners in the US launch, legalize, and grow their businesses.

Guia Negocios (Guia de Negocios LLC) provides LLC formation, EIN acquisition, bilingual bookkeeping, website design, brand identity, and operations support. Content is published in both Spanish and English for entrepreneurs in Knoxville, Nashville, Chattanooga, and across Tennessee.

## Main Pages

- [Inicio (Spanish Home)](https://guianegocios.net/): Primary homepage in Spanish
- [English Home](https://guianegocios.net/en/): Homepage in English
- [Servicios](https://guianegocios.net/es/services/): Full list of business launch and consulting services (Spanish)
- [Services](https://guianegocios.net/en/services/): Service listings (English)
- [Blog y Recursos](https://guianegocios.net/es/blog/): Practical bilingual business guides
- [Preguntas Frecuentes](https://guianegocios.net/es/faq/): Answers about LLC, EIN, licensing in Tennessee
- [Contacto](https://guianegocios.net/es/contact/): Free consultation scheduling

## Key Services

- Tennessee LLC registration and business licensing (bilingual support, SSN not required)
- EIN acquisition for residents and non-residents (ITIN/passport path)
- Bilingual bookkeeping and accounting systems
- Complete business launch bundle (LLC + website + branding + operations)
- CreedaVA bilingual virtual assistant and operations support
